notes: [P1] brief-fidelity: the brief and issue ask for a 'faint range-ring colour token' and a circle drawn 'as a faint outline', but THEME.rangeRing is the fully opaque '#f2c14e', stroked at 1.5px. Only the separate rangeFill token is faint (alpha 0.07). The comment says this matches the Board artboard, but this folder has no design file to check it against. If the artboard ring is meant to be faint, the stroke token should carry alpha.
[P2] scope: drawRange also fills the disc with THEME.rangeFill. The brief asks only for an outline, so this fill is unrequested. It is tested and harmless, but it goes beyond the brief.

[P2] structure: render.js now imports rangePreview from game.js, so the render layer depends on the game module and not only on state. It is acyclic today because game.js does not import render.js, but rangePreview could sit in a pure helper module, or main.js could compute the ring and pass it to draw, so render stays a leaf.
